comparison.objective: Open a hinged panel by holding a spring plunger retracted until its strike clears.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual latch release timing and door pulling against a spring-return mechanism.
comparison.success_condition: Panel reaches the specified opening angle without forcing or damaging the latch/cabinet.
comparison.reason: The record tests sustained latch release during hinge motion. It has no collinear support transfer, circulating bearing elements, or interface-gap containment outcome.
